Case No.: USE PERMIT (UP-2021-04) Location: 117 N. AZUSA AVENUE
Applicant: T-MOBILE
The project consists of a USE PERMIT (UP-2021-04) for the modification of an existing and previously approved wireless telecommunications facility. The project will incorporate the removal of three (3) antennas from a 55’ pole, three (3) remote radio units (RRUS) from the ground, unused coax, equipment, tower mounted amplifiers (TMAS), and diplexers. The project will add six (6) panel antennas, six (6) RRUS, two (2) cabinets, two (2) hard-clad silica (HCS) cables, two (2) power supply units (PSUS), one (1) router, and a new fiberglass roof panel screening at 55’ on the rooftop.
The proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 – Existing Facilities) and Section 15303 (Class 3 – New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures) because for the purposes of CEQA, the proposed project is located on a site that will maintain the existing structures and will not significantly expand. In fact, the site will feature the removal of current equipment onsite to make way for the proposed new upgrades.

2.
Case No.: USE PERMIT (UP-2022-01) Location: 1250 W. FOOTHILL BLVD. #A
Applicant: CHIPOTLE
The project consists of a Use Permit (UP-2022-01) for a drive-through/dine in restaurant and patio dining within an existing shopping center. The applicant requests a Type 47 (On-Sale General – Eating Place) alcohol license issued by the California Department of Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) in an existing restaurant in the DWL (West End Light Industrial District).
The proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 Existing Facilities) because the proposed project involves negligible or no expansion of the existing use.
